g.text: (a) The video is egocentric/first-person perspective, captured from a camera mounted on a drone. A yacht is sailing

text.style: font: 12px 'Times New Roman', 'Nimbus Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: toward the right side of the frame. The drone, hovering at a low altitude over the sea and maintaining its

text.style: font: 12px 'Times New Roman', 'Nimbus Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: gimbal camera angle level with the yacht ahead, slowly rotates to the right to keep the yacht in the center of …

g.text: (b) The video is egocentric/first-person perspective, captured from a camera mounted on a drone. A vehicle is

text.style: font: 12px 'Times New Roman', 'Nimbus Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: driving on a road in the Gobi Desert towards the drone. The drone flies slowly forward while maintaining its

text.style: font: 12px 'Times New Roman', 'Nimbus Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: flight altitude and gimbal camera angle to get a closer perspective of the vehicle.
